name: Get Form Fields
summary: Lists the fields on a form in layout order — labels, data types, validation, visibility rules.
whenToUse: When you want to see what a form asks, or the exact field API names.

response.description: The form's fields in layout order: id (API name), label, dataType, required, validation, visibility rules.

notes: The field id here is the name you pass when submitting leads to this form (Submit Lead Form).
